gpa: A GPA of 3.3 or higher must be maintained across all graded courses counting towards the MS.
grading: All courses taken towards the MS (with the exception of research courses) must be taken for at least 3 units for letter grade and receive a grade of B+ or higher.
policies:
University requirements for the master’s degree include completing 45 units of unduplicated coursework after the bachelor’s degree.
If a Physics Ph.D. student is approved to waive Physics 212, Physics 220, or one of the Quantum Electives for their PhD requirements, they do not need to take those respective waived courses for the MS, but must replace each waived course with another 3-unit Physics or Applied Physics course taken for letter grade.
reviewNotes: The audit checks 45 units, every course letter graded with a B+ or better (research courses offered only S/NC excepted): PHYSICS 212 and 220 and one quantum course, each for at least 3 units. Checked by hand: two 3-unit graduate courses in Physics or Applied Physics, which you move in, the 3-unit minimum for your other courses, the 3.3 GPA, replacement courses if your PhD waived PHYSICS 212, 220 or a quantum elective, and a petition to waive up to six required units if you submit a thesis.
